name: inprocess-obi-apb-timer-no-rvfi-f2f4
description: One pinned Ibex OBI CPU model with no RVFI retirement face (configs/cpus/ibex_obi_local) and one declared 25 MHz PULP APB3 timer.  The unified F1-F6 entry needs a retirement channel for the F1 host trace and refuses this model by name at header time; the refusal is the evidence, and no case line is produced, so nothing claims a retirement or a bus success in its place.
notes: The CPU model exports the OBI request/response channels and probe_irq_taken_pre but assigns no rvfi_* retirement port, so the unified entry refuses the build with "unsupported: F1 needs the CPU rvfi_* retirement probe (...)".  This is the representative no-retirement case; it must not be replaced by a zero or a fetch count.
The target is the same declared 25 MHz composition variant as the timed-CPU scenario, so the refusal is independent of the clock plan (the plan itself is valid).
